title: Networking Fundamentals
description: Networking Fundamentals covers layered models and physical connectivity through Ethernet, addressing, routing, transport, application protocols, wireless, security, cloud networking, and design, closing with monitoring, troubleshooting, professional administration, and an integrated capstone.

topics.title: Network Models and Internet Architecture
topics.description: Explain how layered models, encapsulation, standards, and Internet architecture let heterogeneous systems communicate reliably.

children.title: Conceptual Foundations of Network Models and Internet Architecture
children.description: This subtopic gives students the vocabulary and mental model needed to understand the topic before configuring devices or diagnosing faults.

children.title: Methods and Tools for Network Models and Internet Architecture
children.description: This subtopic turns the concept into professional practice through diagrams, commands, packet analysis, labs, and configuration habits.

children.title: Operational Use of Network Models and Internet Architecture
children.description: This subtopic emphasizes how the topic supports reliable, secure, observable, and business-aligned networks in real organizations.
